title: AS-REP Roasting (Active Directory)
description: A single Samba Active Directory Domain Controller for LAKESIDE.LAB (Lakeside Regional Hospital, a healthcare provider), no Windows VMs. One legacy document-scanner service account (svc-scanner) has Kerberos pre-authentication disabled, so the KDC hands out an AS-REP encrypted with the account's key to anyone who asks, no credentials required. With only a username list, AS-REP roast svc-scanner, crack the hash offline, and read the flag from a share only svc-scanner may open.
question: AS-REP roast the account whose Kerberos pre-authentication is disabled, crack its AS-REP hash offline, and use the recovered password to read the flag from the //dc/imaging share.
